name: Stone Brain
description: A living artifact created by the Sages of Lat-Nam that can compel a wizard to obey another, or give or take away the ability to manipulate mana.

description_citations.text: "Stone Brain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves to the College, where she learns the Stone Brain's true nature.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was then taken underwater by the Lord of Atlantis

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sages create the Stone Brain, which is launched into space instead of being destroyed.
timeline.quote: was instead launched into space

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sages of Lat-Nam build the Stone Brain; they fight over it, then enclose it in a box and launch it into space.
timeline.quote: the sages enclosed it in a box and launched it into space

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull and Greensleeves see the Brain fall as a star; Towser retrieves it, thinking it a mana vault.
timeline.quote: the wizard Towser retrieved it with their help, believing it to be a mana vault

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brain's workings are revealed; Haakon is tested and becomes Greensleeves' slave.
timeline.quote: he became a sort of slave to Greensleeves

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon summons Phyrexian Gremlins who steal the Brain; Greensleeves planeswalks to it and finds she can resist its voices.
timeline.quote: she found out that she could resist the voices

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves dons the helmet and learns its ultimate secret lies in the ruins of Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: She donned the helmet

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic; Gull lets the others keep magic only for good; Greensleeves keeps the last secret to herself.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves used the Stone Brain to strip Towser of his magic

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dacian fights Towser in the destruction of White Ridge, then is pursued and subdued by the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: After fleeing White Ridge , she was pursued by Gull and Greensleeves and was subdued by the Stone Brain .

citation.text: "Mina", section "Dacian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon is captured and placed in the Stone Brain, conjures gremlins to steal it and loses an eye.
timeline.quote: He conjured Phyrexian gremlins to steal the brain, but lost an eye in the process.

citation.text: "Mina", section "Haakon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and Chaney discover the Mana Vault is the Stone Brain, made by the Sages of Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: the fallen star Mana Vault is, in reality, the " Stone Brain "

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Stone Brain is tested on Haakon, who becomes Greensleeves' slave; Gull objects.
timeline.quote: Gull confronts Greensleeves about using the Stone Brain

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Benalish troops kidnap Rakel again; Haakon summons Phyrexian Gremlins who steal the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: who snatch the artifact and return to their home plane

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves summons the survivors to Phyrexia, where demons kill Channa; she dons the Stone Brain and saves her friends.
timeline.quote: who kill the scout Channa

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dacian is captured and made to wear the Stone Brain; Garth arrives furious and is calmed by Rakel.
timeline.quote: The army captures Dacian and puts the helmet on the wizard.

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves dons the Stone Brain and learns its ultimate secret lies in the College of Lat-Nam; Chaney's shade passes into the afterlife.
timeline.quote: The same night, Chaney's shade passes in the afterlife, after reminding Greensleeves once more of the final sacrifice.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves to the underwater College, where she asks a Sage's skull the secret of the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves finds a skull of a Sage, to which she asks the secret of the Stone Brain.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and Chaney learn the Mana Vault is the Stone Brain, and Greensleeves uses it on Haakon.
timeline.quote: the Mana Vault was in reality the Stone Brain

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon summons Phyrexian gremlins who snatch the Stone Brain and return to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: they snatched the artifact and returned to their home plane

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves planeswalks to Phyrexia with friends, dons the Stone Brain, and uses spells from its voices to destroy demons and return home.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was successful in planeswalking to Phyrexia, bringing some of her friends with her.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic with the Stone Brain; the other wizards keep theirs to do good and pledge obedience, and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: who was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "High Wizard of the Domains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Stone Brain falls near White Ridge and wizards converge on the village.
timeline.quote: In 4073 AR , the Stone Brain fell in the woods northwest of White Ridge .

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and her party come to Lat-Nam in 4077 AR to uncover the secrets of the Stone Brain, battling and befriending its guardians.
timeline.quote: After a battle, Greensleeves befriended the guardians and led an excavation

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Battle of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
